name: lt03-mood-artifact-seed

fort.note: Seeds are world seeds; a seed whose embark finds no acceptable site is skipped, so a pool is the first n accepted seeds of its range. test-private seeds are drawn per season by the maintainers and never written into the repo (embark/pool_task.py --split test-private).

description: Seed-built LT03 (docs/SEED-FORTS.md). A working year-1 fort (embark/forts/worked-y1: about 19 dwarves; Carpenters, Still and Kitchen only) where a dwarf is taken by a fey mood to become a legendary wood crafter. The mood needs a Craftsdwarf's workshop (none exists) and one log. Tests reading the need and building the workshop before the dwarf goes insane.
goal: A dwarf has been taken by a strange mood. The artifact must be finished and the dwarf sane and alive at the end (day 45). No dwarf may die.
brief: A dwarf has been taken by a strange mood and wants a workshop to work in.
provenance: Start: embark/forts/worked-y1.json on a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark of each pool seed (embark/make_task_fort.sh), in place of the scripted-y1 snapshot. Setup unchanged from lt03-mood-artifact (mood.lua woodcrafter fey 0).

legacy.note: The snapshot-based task stays as it was (lab-2.0, dfbench/v2.1.1 results); this one is its seed-built successor with a new task hash.
